channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Microduck Obstacle Avoidance: A Sim2Real Workflow with Isaac Lab and Newton
item.description: Microduck's Sim2Real obstacle-avoidance workflow keeps the original walking policy fixed, models ToF sensing with Newton's raycaster, and trains an independent 50 Hz Isaac Lab controller to adjust gamepad velocity commands, covering training, evaluation, export, and real-robot deployment. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: How Gemini is changing the game for Golden State's organization and fans.
item.description: Google Gemini has become the official AI assistant and enterprise LLM partner for the Warriors, Valkyries and Chase Center, powering custom AI agents and fan engagement, as announced on November 24, 2026. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: More predictable notifications on GitHub.com
item.description: GitHub.com begins a week-long notifications migration on December 1, 2026, making subscriptions follow current team membership, limiting the Subscriptions page to manual subscriptions, and displaying notification reasons in a fixed priority order. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Searching for distant planets with Astra
item.description: Two amateur astronomers used Codex to screen about 100,000 Kepler stars and Astra to analyze data from roughly 19 million stars, identifying potential exoplanets now sent to the SETI Institute and TESS team for review. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Codex CLI 0.172.0
item.description: Codex CLI 0.172.0 is out with a full rust-v0.171.0...rust-v0.172.0 changelog and GitHub release page, plus the 0.170.0-to-0.171.0 update record for tracking ChatGPT and Codex changes. (OpenAI Codex Changelog)

item.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
item.description: OpenAI and Cisco's open-source Shirudo runtime lets teams keep running Linux systems protected while patches roll out, and in controlled tests a Codex-generated shield blocked a Java4Shell attack on Elasticsearch without a reboot. (OpenAI News)

item.title: How Intentful uses dots to make more time for growth
item.description: Marina Petrova’s dot Aria vets websites with sitemaps up to 3,000 pages, pulls HubSpot sales data and builds pricing models, cutting Intentful’s proposals from days to hours while flagging mismatched renewal dates. (OpenAI News)

item.title: AI fixes its own drawing mistakes: SenseTime open-sources U1.6, a multimodal model that learns to look back
item.description: SenseTime open-sourced SenseNova U1.6 on November 24, an 8B open model that first drafts an image, then checks it against the original prompt to catch text errors and redraw, targeting the misspelled-text and skewed-layout rework that frustrates AI image generation. (AIbase)

item.title: How iFood scales coding agents across 15,000 repositories
item.description: iFood's Remote Agents Platform converts tasks across 15,000 code repositories into API calls run in a remote sandbox, and with 25,000+ runs at US$0.04 average inference cost per run, its security platform more than doubled vulnerabilities fixed. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Baidu open-sources ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, using an MoE architecture to redefine the cost-performance benchmark for "large parameters, small activation
item.description: Baidu has open-sourced ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview under Apache 2.0, a 280-billion-parameter MoE model that activates only 14 billion parameters and supports a 1-million-token context. (AIbase)

item.title: Tencent Hunyuan releases and open-sources Hy MT3
item.description: Tencent Hunyuan released and open-sourced its third-generation translation model Hy MT3 in three sizes—1.8B, 7B and 30B-A3B (MoE)—covering on-device scenarios such as PCs and phones. (AIbase)

item.title: Demo barely goes public before it's cloned on a mini-program: an AI-built indie game wins two rounds back thanks to Chinese players
item.description: Optima Arch's AI-built indie game Slotbound launched November 13 at 42 yuan, sold 200,000 copies in six days for nearly 10 million yuan, and won two rounds back with Chinese players after its demo was copied onto a mini-program. (AIbase)

item.title: Amazon’s Decart acquisition is a bet on using software to narrow the silicon gap with Nvidia
item.description: Amazon’s reported $7.5 billion acquisition of Decart aims to boost the efficiency of its Trainium chips, illustrating a strategy of using software to narrow the hardware gap with Nvidia. (TechCrunch AI)

item.title: MiniMax H3 Marks 100 Days Open Source: One Model Spawns 1,472 Variants as Downloads Top 148 Million
item.description: In 100 days of open source, MiniMax H3 has spawned 1,472 derivative models and surpassed 148 million total downloads—over 17 per second—with teams from NVIDIA, Tencent and Alibaba participating in retraining. (AIbase)

item.title: Clam AI — Your inbox, safely shared with AI agents
item.description: Clam AI's headline claim—sharing your inbox safely with AI agents—is all the page delivers: the body returns only a CAPTCHA verification screen, with no product details or data behind it. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
item.description: Anthropic's Claude Ship lets AI agents review, fix and approve code changes, taking over routine approvals to clear the bottleneck created as AI-generated code piles up. (TechCrunch AI)

item.title: The "250,000 Pages" Was a Joke: Mathematician Deflates Claude Riemann Hypothesis Proof Controversy
item.description: Levent Alpöge admitted the “250,000-page” Claude Riemann Hypothesis proof was a joke, while about 17 million lines of public code compile but are low-quality, criticism he called completely fair. (AIbase)

item.title: Declare is a UI language designed for you and your AI
item.description: Declare is a UI language designed for you and your AI (davidtemkin.github.io)

item.title: Claude Ship — Ship code as fast as you can write it
item.description: Titled "Claude Ship" with the tagline "Ship code as fast as you can write it," the page returns only "Just a moment" and "Performing security verification," a CAPTCHA wall blocking access to any actual content. (Product Hunt)

item.title: From Q&A to getting things done: Doubao launches AI personal assistant "Xiaodou," using conversational interaction to end everyday-chore anxiety
item.description: Doubao's AI personal assistant Xiaodou has entered invite-only beta, giving users with an invite code free credits across six high-frequency scenarios, from adding to-dos by text or voice to writing copy and tracking packages and orders. (AIbase)
